title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.06830）：MemPilot 把 agent memory 从'query-agnostic preprocessing / specialized operations'拉到'on-demand multimodal memory curation at inference'——在 agent runtime 才决定哪些 memory 要 curate / 怎么处理、保持对 performance-cost tradeoff 的 flexible control。是 context-engineering × ai-agent × multimodal-agent 的'on-demand multimodal memory'趋势资产——'runtime memory curation'范式可迁移到任何'agent memory governance'子方向（retrieval trigger / write decision / memory compression），与昨日 / 上周 context-engineering × memory 主线在'agent controls its own memory budget'层面同源。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 on-demand 触发协议、multimodal memory 形式化、跨 agent task 验证、与 query-agnostic memory baseline 对照。
